limits: Focused GCC and Clang gates pass. Review catalog dependencies retain inherited non-inline legacy definitions; the broad multi-TU probe has the same 80 strong symbols with or without the new adapters under both compilers. Native workers use one translation unit; broader legacy ODR cleanup remains separate.
Native SVG is the implemented backend. Sampled RF and actual corrupted-codec decoding are unavailable capabilities.
MPEG studies implement concealment and source history. Low-bitrate quantization and ringing remain unimplemented.
Receiver and CRT timing are documented native interpretations, without new provider-specific or hardware-recording calibration.
Historical external-corpus and optional-integration drivers are classified separately; native coverage is not a claim that every legacy CLI runs without its required inputs.
Stepped SVG proofing clips differ from the separately verified continuous MKV deliveries.
The compact review PDF uses lossless 100 dpi artwork crops and vector annotations. Full vector PDF/SVGs retain detail for high magnification.

PDF viewers rasterize vector geometry and resample embedded images at their display scale. Subpixel scanlines can shift apparent color at some zoom levels; the CRT comparison confirms identical source/state and solid colors. Compact lossless-crop exactness applies to decoded image data, not arbitrary viewer raster pixels.
Movie per-frame SVGs and supplied history sequences are temporary. Book SVGs/recipes, exact frame hashes/history receipts, catalog/composition inputs, sampled PNGs and renderer sources are retained.
Technical checks and assistant inspection do not constitute human artistic approval.
